exact_local_scope.normalization: gaussianLog z is the exact normalized coefficient times exp(-(principal complex log z)^2/4), and gaussianLog(y:ℂ)=the existing exact P y. No unnormalized substitute or entire-function assertion is introduced.
exact_local_scope.power_bound: For z≠0 and every real a, the actual principal-log imaginary bound and completing-square inequality yield a concrete norm upper bound proportional to||z||^(-a). The nonzero premise is explicit.

exact_local_scope.disk: For y∈[1/2,2], complex closed radius1/4 disks have norms in[1/4,9/4] and positive real part. The proof establishes an actual scale-uniform disk norm bound, then DiffContOnCl and the actual sphere bound for Cauchy.
exact_local_scope.main_statement: For every a:ℝ and n:ℕ there exists C>0 such that, for every r>0 and y∈[1/2,2], ||iteratedDeriv n(fun x=>P(r*x)) y||≤C*r^(-a). C may depend on(a,n), not r or y. The supplied C is factorial(n)*diskBound/(1/4)^n.
